subject: MAP transfer + evaluation timeline: Solaron Health onboarding
body:
Message 1:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Grant <amelia@solaronhealth.com>, Noah Patel <noah.p@solaronhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP transfer + evaluation timeline: Solaron Health onboarding

Hi Amelia / Noah —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get Solaron Health into the evaluation. I wanted to loop in our Customer Success team and share a first pass mutual action plan (attached) so we can align on owners, milestones, and the close/eval timeline. High-level proposed cadence:

- Week 0 (this week): kick-off, SSO & network checks, test dataset handoff
- Week 1: evaluation run (1–2 models), latency/cost baselines, preliminary regressions
- Week 2: feature validation (API integrations, embeddings quality), remediation items
- Week 3: executive readout and next steps (production plan / Dedicated capacity options)

Owners I’m proposing: Rafael Mendes (Sales, deal owner), Marissa Cole (Customer Success, CSM), Karthik Iyer (Onboarding Engineer). Please confirm if those owners make sense and share any additional stakeholders to include.

I attached: Solaron_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (MAP) and SOW-Solaron-Health-draft.docx.

Proposed kickoff: Wed Feb 23, 10:00 AM PT — does that work for you? If not, offer two alternative slots and we’ll adapt.

Next steps for Amelia/Noah: 
- Confirm kickoff slot and attendees (security, infra, evaluation lead)
- Share test dataset access details or sample telemetry we can use for baseline runs

Thanks — looking forward to a fast evaluation.

Best,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Solaron_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: SOW-Solaron-Health-draft.docx]

-----
Message 2:
From: Amelia Grant <amelia@solaronhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP transfer + evaluation timeline: Solaron Health onboarding

Thanks Rafael — this looks great and congrats on getting us across the line. Wed Feb 23 at 10:00 AM PT should work for me (I'll confirm with Noah). Two quick items up front: 

1) SSO: we need to validate SAML with our IdP (Okta) — who will own that piece?
2) Data retention & audit logs: our security team will need a short note describing how logs are retained and where audit trails live during the evaluation.

I'll confirm attendees by end of today.

—Amelia
Amelia Grant
Head of Data & ML Engineering
Solaron Health

-----
Message 3:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Grant <amelia@solaronhealth.com>, Noah Patel <noah.p@solaronhealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP transfer + evaluation timeline: Solaron Health onboarding

Hi Amelia / Noah —

Thanks for the quick reply and the heads-up on security items. I'll own SSO coordination with your IdP and hand that over to Karthik for the technical setup. To address the audit/log question: I'll attach a short one-pager that summarizes our evaluation data model, retention policy for evaluation artifacts (30 days by default for MAP evaluations), and how customers can request extended retention. That doc will be uploaded to the drive link below.

I pulled a slimmed-down MAP that highlights milestones and owners (attached as MAP_v1-CS). Key asks from CS for kickoff:
- Confirm evaluation lead (person responsible for dataset & validation criteria)
- Provide VPN or temporary test bucket access details for Karthik
- Identify security reviewer for the SSO checklist (name + email)

Proposed attendees for kickoff (we can trim):
- Solaron: Amelia (Data/ML), Noah (Infrastructure), security rep
- Redwood: Marissa (CS lead), Karthik (onboarding), Rafael (sales exec)

Kickoff slots I can cover: Wed Feb 23, 10:00 AM PT (preferred) or Thu Feb 24, 9:00 AM PT. Here's a short link to the MAP in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/solaron/onboarding-map

I'll upload the retention one-pager and the CS-specific MAP after this thread.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: MAP_v1-CS.pdf]
[Related link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/solaron/onboarding-map]

-----
Message 4:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Amelia Grant <amelia@solaronhealth.com>, Noah Patel <noah.p@solaronhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP transfer + evaluation timeline: Solaron Health onboarding

All — quick clarifications:
- Decision-maker / procurement: Emily Serrano (VP Product) will sign off on production purchase; Emily is looped in on the procurement thread but not required for the MAP kickoff.
- SOW redline: legal will push a marked-up SOW by EOD Monday (I've flagged the team).
- For the SSO integration, Marissa/Karthik will want Okta metadata and a test user — Noah, can you create a tenant/test account and send SAML metadata to karthik.iyer@redwood.ai?

I'll coordinate the SOW redline and keep everyone posted. Rafael

-----
Message 5:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Grant <amelia@solaronhealth.com>, Noah Patel <noah.p@solaronhealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-22T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP transfer + evaluation timeline: Solaron Health onboarding

Perfect — thanks Rafael. Amelia / Noah: Wed Feb 23, 10:00 AM PT is on my calendar and I've created a short kickoff agenda (I will share in the Drive folder). Noah, if you can add the security contact to this thread and drop the Okta metadata link for Karthik, we can start the SAML exchange immediately.

Quick note on evaluation access: we will provision a sandbox API key scoped to the MAP (read-only for the first 48 hours, then expanded for validation tests) and share notebook examples for at least two validation tasks.

See you on Wed — Marissa

[Attachment uploaded to Drive: CS_MAP_v1.pdf]
[Related link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/solaron/onboarding-map]
